    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM first_loan_account)
      AND t.date <= '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_end AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, t.balance AS end_balance
    FROM trans t

)

    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS growth_rate

JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
